requirement.statement: depa-actor SHALL expose generic stack hydration APIs so interpreter runtimes can restore stack snapshots without mutating private fields.

case.given: A StackMachine has been created and later receives a previously captured StackMachineState
case.when: The runtime hydrates the stack from that state
case.then: The stack SHALL replace its items and frame bottoms through a public API and validate frame boundaries

case.given: Existing callers create instruction and operand stacks from snapshot state
case.when: The new hydration API is added
case.then: Existing createInstructionStack(state) and createOperandStack(state) behavior SHALL remain compatible

requirement.statement: depa-actor SHALL provide domain-neutral dispatcher hooks or yield conventions that allow interpreter runtimes to stop at safe points and return effects to an outer runtime.

case.given: An instruction handler produces an effect that requires host runtime processing
case.when: The handler asks the dispatcher to yield
case.then: The dispatcher SHALL stop cleanly, preserve collected effects, and report a stop reason distinguishable from error and stack exhaustion

case.given: A runtime wants to observe instruction dispatch
case.then: The runtime SHALL be able to observe before-instruction, after-instruction, handler-effect, and stop events through domain-neutral hooks or equivalent APIs

requirement.statement: depa-actor SHALL keep snapshot and fiber orchestration helpers domain-neutral while allowing higher-level runtimes to attach custom metadata.

case.given: A higher-level interpreter runtime serializes custom checkpoint metadata
case.when: The runtime uses depa-actor snapshot helper types
case.then: The helper SHALL allow opaque metadata without requiring depa-actor to understand Kunun, AI agent, or dynamic workflow semantics

case.given: depa-actor is used by actor systems, interpreters, and AI OS kernels
case.when: dynamic workflow support is added in a dependent project
case.then: depa-actor SHALL NOT introduce built-in AI agent runtime, prompt, JSON schema, or workflow-specific concepts
